title: Gotta find another one
body:
I’ve paid for a premium subscription a while ago. Now they’ve changed to a monthly/annual program and, EVERYTIME I OPEN THE APP, THERE’S AN ADD TO THE NEW METHOD.

In the description here at the App Store, they say you can track three habits for free, but right now it’s only accepting two. If I click to add a third one, the add flashes again. 

If the objective of the Done crew is to loose users and costumers, they’re doing a pretty good job!

title: Scam?!
body: People who already paid for the full version of the app are being “suggested” to pay again (a ridiculous price). This is a scam! If the app change the type of payment this has to be applied only for new members. You can’t remove functions from people who already paid them in the past. You have to update the app and give the old buyers the functionalities we used to have or I am not exaggerating saying that you are doing a fraude.

title: Simple and effective
body:
I tested almost 10 apps. There are cool apps out there, but they didn't fit my routine. I needed something simple and effective, to use at home and at work, on the bus, for quick entries.

 They need to improve the reports. Controlling categories of goals should be useful. It's very important to add a global indicator, that shows the percentage achieved in a week, considering all goals together. We have only separated reports.
